Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D pixel game character ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for one growth age of Ian, based on the attached official ADULT identity reference ONLY. NEWBORN AGE ZERO: anatomically baby proportions, oversized soft head, extremely short arms and legs, short fine tousled black hair, sleepy eyes, soft charcoal romper and cream swaddle. NO HEADPHONES. NO STANDING, NO WALKING. Draw lying baby poses. Rows0-3: each row eight different tiny lying poses: awake two, arm/leg wiggle three, crying/being gently held/fed/bathed with parent hands three. Row4 sleeping2,waking2,being held2,settling2. Row5 feeding2,care drink2,face wipe2,parent-supported bath2. Row6 parent-supported bath2,hugged by parent hands2,toy play2,reaching toy2. Row7 soothing2,reaching2,babbling2,toy play2. Only the baby and necessary adult hands for care, never a full standing adult.
TRANSPARENT background, no scene, no floor, no UI, no text, no grid lines. EXACTLY 8 COLUMNS x 8 ROWS, 64 equally spaced square cells, square image. Keep every complete sprite centered within its cell, no clipping and no sprite crossing a cell boundary. Consistent fixed character height and anatomy across all 64 cells of this age. Pixel art clusters, desaturated colors, crisp controlled edges, front/top-down RPG camera. Animate actual limbs/eyes/body between frames, never repeat the exact same pose or just move/resize it. Each sprite entirely contained with transparent margin, feet aligned to the same cell baseline, camera stationary. The final sheet is sliced into 64 individual Unity Sprites.
Use the newborn row specification above.
Make this SAME person at the specified age; retain identity in black hair and tired eyes, not an unrelated cute mascot. Adult reference remains unmodified. No captions or age numerals.

furniture.note: Second built-in edit removed the white background; native Sprite.Create slices, no Python painting or alpha modification.

limitations: Generated derivatives require human pixel cleanup and identity review; not final approved pixel art.
Youth interaction actions currently authored only in Down; missing directions explicitly fall back within the same age bank.
Turn/Stop reuse directional Idle; CareFeed for walking children uses their eating frames.
Guardian hands are animated; full parent NPC receiving a request, walking from another room and carrying the child is not yet connected.

guardianBath.description: Two original toddler bath poses with visible guardian hands, a shallow bowl and safe soapsuds. Built-in image_gen edit using toddler atlas as reference.
